G01_INPUT_SNAPSHOT_COVERAGE.gap: Agent-008 snapshots hold only S004,S005,S025 (phase0) and S026,S027 (motion); build_shot_spec fails SHOT_NOT_IN_MANIFEST for the other 24.
G01_INPUT_SNAPSHOT_COVERAGE.smallest_change: Run the existing read-only agent008/tools/snapshot_inputs.py once for all 29 shots and commit the snapshot (no code change).

G02_PRODUCTION_STILL_SHOT_PATH.gap: Still shots render only through the Phase-0 stand-in path, hard-wired to S004/S005 and a NON-CANON layout.
G02_PRODUCTION_STILL_SHOT_PATH.smallest_change: Add compose_still_shot(approved_frame_sha, spec_shot, timing): hold a hash-verified approved/derived frame for N frames and reuse the existing treatment, mix (incl. dialogue) and encode functions.

G03_OVERLAY_ANCHOR_PLACEMENT.gap: Berry overlays have no placement spec on production frames (face plus mirrored reflection).
G03_OVERLAY_ANCHOR_PLACEMENT.smallest_change: A per-frame anchor JSON (x, y, scale, rotation, mirror flag) per overlay, human-approved, applied deterministically; reused for static shots and for pre-compositing smudges into base frames before provider upload.

G04_DERIVED_FRAME_FROM_APPROVED_MOTION.gap: No governed way to take the last (or Nth) frame of an approved RAW_MOTION_SOURCE as the base of the next shot.
G04_DERIVED_FRAME_FROM_APPROVED_MOTION.smallest_change: Deterministic extract (ffmpeg, exact frame index) recorded with source SHA, frame index and output SHA; registered SHOT_FRAME/DERIVED_FRAME after human approval.

G05_ROLE_AWARE_MAPPED_AUDIO.gap: spec mapped_audio mixes FOLEY-CLOTH-SOFT-v01 and SFX-COMPLETION-POP-v01 as looped full-length beds (mix_motion_audio/BED). Only AMBIENCE should be a bed.
G05_ROLE_AWARE_MAPPED_AUDIO.smallest_change: Split mapped_audio by registry subtype: AMBIENCE = bed; FOLEY/SFX = timed one-shot cues requiring timing (fail closed without), as named_sfx already does.

G06_KEYFRAMED_CROP_SCALE.gap: No deterministic camera settle (S024) on stills.
G06_KEYFRAMED_CROP_SCALE.smallest_change: Keyframed crop/scale ramp (start rect -> end rect, smoothstep) on a still, within source resolution (no upscale beyond 1.0).

G07_IN_SHOT_CUT.gap: S018 needs an adjustment segment then a cut to macro inside one shot.
G07_IN_SHOT_CUT.smallest_change: Two-segment shot: concatenate two deterministic segments at an exact frame; provenance per segment.

G08_TREATMENTS_ON_STILL_PRODUCTION.gap: Glint, reflection and pop-accent primitives exist; only the glint has run (Phase-0). Reflection/pop not executed in a production path.
G08_TREATMENTS_ON_STILL_PRODUCTION.smallest_change: Wire treatments.TREATMENTS into G02 with frame windows from timing; reflection only if the frame does not already contain a readable reflection.

G09_DIALOGUE_OVERLAP_AND_HOLD_GUARD.gap: resolve_dialogue supports N slots, but does not reject overlapping clips or clips inside protected holds/before-cue windows.
G09_DIALOGUE_OVERLAP_AND_HOLD_GUARD.smallest_change: Add non-overlap and window checks to resolve_dialogue (fail closed).

G10_WHOOSH_HASH_PIN.gap: SFX-MIKKO-TRY-WHOOSH has no registry SHA and no hash pin, so Agent-008 fails closed on S007.
G10_WHOOSH_HASH_PIN.smallest_change: Read-only storage hash audit and a committed hash pin (data, not code).

G11_TRACKED_OVERLAY_REMOVAL.gap: S009/S015/S021 need a smudge to vanish exactly under a provider-generated moving cloth.
G11_TRACKED_OVERLAY_REMOVAL.smallest_change: Not small: requires tracking (or a human-designed masked crossfade on an occluding frame window). Needs its own design decision before any spend.
